structured_output.content: The release notes only say that v1.18.0 adds the `iss` short name for the cert-manager `Issuer` resource. This is a new feature, and the excerpt does not say it changes any existing behaviour. The environment summary lists only the `certificates.cert-manager.io` [v1] CRD and `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifests, with no Issuer CRD or Issuer manifests, so nothing shown here is affected by the change. If you manage Issuers or use other CRDs not shown in this summary, you can check whether any of them already uses `iss` as a short name, but the cited evidence doesn't describe any such risk.
